[package]
name = "async-imap"
version = "0.11.2"
authors = ["dignifiedquire <me@dignifiedquire.com>"]
documentation = "https://docs.rs/async-imap/"
repository = "https://github.com/async-email/async-imap"
homepage = "https://github.com/async-email/async-imap"
description = "Async IMAP client for Rust"
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["email", "imap"]
categories = ["email", "network-programming"]

[badges.maintenance]
status = "actively-developed"

[badges.is-it-maintained-issue-resolution]
repository = "async-email/async-imap"

[badges.is-it-maintained-open-issues]
repository = "async-email/async-imap"

[features]
default = ["runtime-async-std"]
compress = ["async-compression"]
runtime-async-std = ["async-std", "async-compression?/futures-io"]
runtime-tokio = ["tokio", "async-compression?/tokio"]

[dependencies]
async-channel = "2.0.0"
base64 = "0.22.1"
bytes = "1"
futures = "0.3.15"
imap-proto = "0.16.4"
log = "0.4.8"
nom = "7.0"
pin-project = "1"
pin-utils = "0.1.0-alpha.4"
self_cell = "1.0.1"
stop-token = "0.7"
thiserror = "1.0.9"

[dependencies.async-compression]
version = "0.4.15"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]
optional = true

[dependencies.async-std]
version = "1.8.0"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "unstable"]
optional = true

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["net", "sync", "time", "io-util"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
pretty_assertions = "1.2"

[dev-dependencies.async-std]
version = "1.8.0"
features = ["std", "attributes"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros"]
